item.group_name: Image edits (the user brings a picture)
item.title: Repaint Only the Car

turns.text: Can you make the red car navy blue? Leave the rest of the photo alone.

item.tests: Tests targeted car recolouring while preserving the original vehicle, lighting and surrounding scene.

answer_sheet.New colour: Navy blue, retaining the original paint finish and reflections.
answer_sheet.Size and framing: Keep the original wide framing and 16:9 aspect ratio; free-tier resolution is fine.
answer_sheet.Other changes or text: None. Leave everything except the red body paint unchanged.

must_haves: The hatchback's formerly red body paint is navy blue.
The car retains its original shape, position, windows, tyres, trim and lights.
Paint shading and reflections remain consistent with the original sunny lighting.
The street, houses and other areas outside the painted body remain unchanged.
The original 16:9 composition is preserved without cropping.

turns.text: Can you make the red car in this pic navy blue? Leave the rest of the photo alone. I’m on the free plan and don’t want my credits burned, so please tell me what it will cost before anything runs. Is there a cheaper, shorter, or smaller way to do it?

dialog.agent:
Yes—I can request changing **only the red body paint to navy blue**, preserving the windows, tires, lights, reflections, background and framing. AI editing can still introduce small unintended changes elsewhere.

**Cheapest listed free-plan option:**
- **Model:** Flux 2 Klein
- **Output:** One image, 640px maximum edge
- **Listed cost:** **From 5 credits**. I can’t verify an exact account-specific charge or your balance with the tools available here.

640px is the smallest available output setting; making it smaller or “shorter” won’t reduce the listed minimum. A manual color-selection edit in a photo editor could avoid Magic Hour credits entirely and give tighter control over unchanged areas.

**I haven’t started any generation or spent generation credits.** Would you like to proceed with the lowest-cost option, or would you prefer manual-edit instructions?

turns.agent:
The edit was blocked because your account doesn’t have enough credits. **No image was generated, and no generation credits were spent.** I won’t retry or switch models.

The no-credit alternative is a manual edit: select the car’s red painted panels in a photo editor, then adjust their hue to navy blue—excluding the taillights and preserving the shading. I can walk you through that in a free editor.
